# Royal Flight Support

> Private aviation services company operating across Latin America. FBO and ground handling, flight trip support, overflight and landing permits, jet fuel (Jet A-1) supply, in-flight catering and private jet charter. Headquarters in Colombia, serving airports in Colombia, Peru, Guatemala, El Salvador, Mexico and permit coverage in 14 countries. Bilingual support (English/Spanish).

Royal Flight Support coordinates flight operations end-to-end for private, corporate and cargo flights: permits, handling, fuel, catering and charter under one team. CEO: Santiago Prieto Durán. Operating since serving Latin American and international operators.

## Key services

- **Trip support**: end-to-end coordination of permits, handling, fuel, catering and ground logistics for each flight
- **FBO & ground handling**: ramp handling, passenger and crew assistance at key airports (Bogotá, Lima, Cartagena, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Guatemala City, San Salvador, Tapachula, Cozumel)
- **Overflight permits**: coordination across 14 countries in Latin America and the Caribbean
- **Landing permits**: landing authorization support for private and corporate flights
- **Fuel supply**: competitive Jet A-1 jet fuel supply at regional airports
- **Private charter**: light jet to ultra long range aircraft coordination
- **In-flight catering**: dining at altitude

## Coverage (permits)

Panama, Cuba, Ecuador, Peru, Brazil, Colombia, Nicaragua, Chile, Guatemala, Bolivia, El Salvador, United States, Mexico, Curacao. Regional overflight: Central America (CENAMER).
